name: Gwyn
source: Behind Gwyn's chivalrous and kind smile is a truly mysterious man who gives almost nothing away. As a member of the Special Forces, he's very capable but seems to have a mischievous streak. Gwyn tries to look out for you, even if his methods are questionable. You start to realize that maybe he doesn't trust people for a reason. Are you going to be able to help him have a little more faith in humanity?
